description: Overrides beyond the shared preset: OSV vulnerability alerts, the `dependencies` label, PR automerge and lockfile maintenance, package rules that group and automerge non-major updates while leaving the go directive to devbox-update, vulnerability-alert labelling and automerge, and strict constraints filtering.

packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree.
